flavour.unique:windwhisper: Every arrow it gives has a twin, and every twin knows the way.
flavour.unique:stormweaver_coil: The storm does not choose. It answers.
flavour.unique:ashen_crown: It still smoulders where the king's thoughts burned.
flavour.unique:mountainheart: Stone does not ask whether the storm is fire or ice.
flavour.unique:oathbreaker: Every vow ends. Most end loudly. The deep-realm smiths had a word for that sound: Carnage.
flavour.unique:hearthfire: Warm hands, warm home, a burned village behind.
flavour.unique:thornhide: The forest remembers who bled it.
flavour.unique:pilgrims_stride: One more mile. Always one more mile.
flavour.unique:eye_of_the_tempest: At the centre of every storm, a single calm thought.
flavour.unique:mouth_of_the_mire: What the marsh swallows, it keeps.
flavour.unique:glass_soul: Beautiful, brilliant, and one fall from pieces.
flavour.unique:warlords_girdle: Tighten it and the fear goes somewhere else.
flavour.unique:emberheart_vest: Carry the fire close and it carries you.
flavour.unique:the_first_vow: The blade you woke with. It remembered every promise you broke since, and the sky keeps its swords for it.
flavour.unique:squires_promise: Every oath begins with a blade held out, hilt first.
flavour.unique:crook_of_the_vale: Cut from the first birch that ever caught a storm.
flavour.unique:wintercall_orb: Hold it to your ear and you hear the snow falling on a world that has not ended yet.
flavour.unique:crown_of_the_bone_king: He ruled the dead the way he ruled the living: by keeping them warm. Skorch's embers never cooled.
flavour.unique:soulreaper: It does not cut. It collects.
flavour.unique:hand_of_dawn: At first light the hammers wake, and circle the one who still keeps the oath.
flavour.unique:aegis_of_the_oath: The oath was never the knight's to break. It was the armour's to keep.
flavour.unique:the_pilgrims_pyre: He walked into the fire to keep his word. He never walked out of it.
flavour.unique:stormstring: Strung with a hair of the storm. It hums before the thunder does, and the wolves of the Passage of Ash answer.
flavour.unique:engineers_lodestone: The siege-wrights of the Sylvan march carried no swords. They carried this.
flavour.unique:twin_fangs_of_the_ronin: One to draw, one to finish. He never needed a third.
flavour.unique:shadowsilk_wraps: Spun in a room with no light, by hands that never stopped moving.
flavour.unique:cyclones_eye: At the centre of the storm it is very quiet. Everything else is screaming.
flavour.unique:deephall_bulwark: It held the gate of the deep hall for nine winters. The dwarves only asked that it come home.
flavour.unique:brokkr_fang: Brokkr forged the fang, his brother the edge. Neither would say which was the better.
flavour.unique:sindri_edge: Sindri forged the edge, his brother the fang. Wield both and settle the argument.
flavour.unique:stonefist_wraps: The mountain king fought with his hands, and the mountain remembered every blow.
flavour.unique:frostfeather_quiver: Fletched with owl down and frost.
flavour.unique:ironroot_signet: Rooted, it does not run. It does not need to.
flavour.unique:webspinner_gloves: Every thread hums. Something is listening.
flavour.unique:aftershock_greaves: Where you land, the ground remembers.
flavour.unique:wand_of_the_ash_march: They march warm, and they leave warmer.
flavour.unique:shatterglass_pendant: Break one, and the pieces keep going.
flavour.unique:siphoning_lattice: Drink slowly. There is always more.
flavour.unique:thrice_sworn_sash: Three knots: one for each promise you meant.
flavour.unique:galeheart_greataxe: The wind does not tire. Neither should you.
flavour.unique:lightsworn_reliquary: Bright things do not die quietly.
flavour.unique:thunderwake_maul: The hammers follow the one who does not stop.
flavour.unique:overload_coil: A little spark, kept close, keeps everything burning.
flavour.unique:starcallers_staff: Ask the sky once. It answers twice.
flavour.unique:the_oath_unbroken: Every other oath in the world was broken. Not this one.
flavour.unique:signet_of_the_lost_order_chain_re: The Order kept one oath each. The ring remembers which.
flavour.unique:signet_of_the_lost_order_iron_res: The Order kept one oath each. The ring remembers which.
flavour.unique:signet_of_the_lost_order_blood_ma: The Order kept one oath each. The ring remembers which.
flavour.unique:signet_of_the_lost_order_elementa: The Order kept one oath each. The ring remembers which.
flavour.unique:signet_of_the_lost_order_spellbla: The Order kept one oath each. The ring remembers which.
flavour.unique:signet_of_the_lost_order_hollow_c: The Order kept one oath each. The ring remembers which.
flavour.unique:shroud_of_the_restless_gale: The dead do not rest. Wrap them in the gale and they stop trying.
flavour.unique:emberstride_treads: Every step away is a step they cannot follow.
flavour.unique:diadem_of_the_storm_choir: They sang for the storm once. Dead throats remember the tune.
flavour.unique:hollowhorn: Carved from a horn that once called the dead to war. It still does.
flavour.unique:frostbloom_signet: Winter keeps what falls. Then it blooms.
flavour.unique:thundercoil_gauntlets: Coiled wire under the plate. It hums on the fourth blow.
flavour.unique:oathfire_censer: Swing it and the old vows smoulder. Hold it still and they burn.
flavour.unique:bulwark_of_the_last_gate: The last gate never fell. The sky made sure of it.
flavour.unique:gravewalkers_girdle: Every bone owes a debt. The girdle collects.
flavour.unique:tidebreaker_maul: Forged for a giant who wanted the sea to stop. It stopped.
flavour.unique:wyrmblade_of_the_black_oath: A black wyrm swore on this blade. Then it broke the oath, and the blade kept the fire.
flavour.unique:ring_of_echoing_oaths: Say it once and mean it. The ring says it again.
flavour.unique:gravecleaver: It never learned the difference between a foe and a recruit.
flavour.unique:dawnforge_maul: Forged at first light, quenched in an oath. It still remembers the morning.
flavour.unique:stormfang: The storm bit the blade once. The blade learned to bite back.
flavour.unique:vowfire_cuirass: Strike the one who swore. The vow strikes back.
flavour.unique:rimeheart_wand: Its heart froze first. Everything it points at follows.
flavour.unique:gravesong: It hums when something dies. The dead hum back.
flavour.unique:orrery_of_the_long_night: Seven cold moons, and a night that will not end until they do.
flavour.unique:the_thousand_sparks: Every finger a storm. Every storm a little smaller.
flavour.unique:the_unfallen_ancestor: He was told to hold the pass until relieved. No one ever came.
flavour.unique:quiver_of_the_last_watch: Plant the bolts. Hold the wall. Do not look back.
flavour.unique:hexbinders_censer: Swing it once, and the whole room is guilty.
flavour.unique:the_red_hunger: It was never the blood. It was the next one.
flavour.unique:standard_of_the_last_legion: The legion fell. The standard did not.
flavour.unique:the_hunters_promise: Run if you like. I have already marked where you will fall.
flavour.unique:ossuary_lantern: Its light shows the dead where to aim.
flavour.unique:charnel_bell: Ring it once and they rise. Ring it twice and they rise burning.
flavour.unique:the_splitting_psalm: One word, sung once. The choir answers from every side.
flavour.unique:plaguewrights_grasp: Wash your hands, the old healers said. He never did.
flavour.unique:halo_of_the_restless_saint: She never stopped walking. The light never stopped turning.
flavour.unique:the_last_volley: The sky over the pass was black with them. It still is.
flavour.unique:rimecrown_staff: Winter does not ask the river. It simply stops it.
flavour.unique:the_blackbile_censer: Breathe it in. Everyone does, in the end.
flavour.unique:the_headsmans_grip: One clean stroke. The rest is paperwork.
flavour.unique:the_wolfs_due: The pack does not wait for the kill to start feeding.
flavour.unique:kingbreaker: Crowns are only metal. Metal bends.
flavour.unique:the_snarewrights_belt: Never stand where you fight. Stand where they will.
flavour.unique:the_gate_that_answers: Strike the gate, and the gate strikes back.
flavour.unique:the_reckoners_wraps: Count every blow. Then pay them all back at once.
flavour.unique:reliquary_of_the_second_dawn: The first dawn was promised. The second one you call yourself.
flavour.unique:the_blackbile_seal: Pressed into the wax of every oath the swamp ever took.
flavour.unique:the_eleventh_cut: Ten cuts are a fight. The eleventh is a sentence.
flavour.unique:girdle_of_the_turning_earth: Strike the earth often enough and it starts striking with you.
flavour.unique:heart_of_the_white_silence: The winter does not hurry. It only ever needs one more night.
flavour.unique:the_sextons_last_candle: He lit it for the last grave he dug. It never went out, and neither did the rot.
flavour.unique:crown_of_the_seventh_verdict: Six verdicts were read aloud. The seventh was carried out.
flavour.unique:quiver_of_the_ninth_storm: Eight storms were caught in it. The ninth is still deciding.
flavour.unique:breastplate_of_the_long_verdict: The verdict was long. The sentence was carried out in one swing, and then another.
flavour.unique:the_last_cut: A thousand cuts is a number. The last one is a promise.
flavour.unique:the_siege_wrights_vow: She swore the wall would fall before the siege did. She built one more engine to be sure.
flavour.unique:the_ossuary_chorus: Every bone in the ossuary knew the hymn. It only needed someone to start it.
flavour.unique:the_widows_patience: She never chased anyone. She only ever waited where they would walk.
flavour.unique:community_aarons_golemheart: I never had one friend made of stone. I had two, and neither ever left my side.
flavour.unique:community_graxxys_tinderhands: I never set a hundred traps. I set the first one, and it set the rest.
flavour.unique:community_lizards_quakestride: I hit the ground once. The ground hits back for me.
flavour.unique:community_binas_spotters_helm: I call the shot. Every engine on the wall hears me.
flavour.unique:cinderwick: I never needed the fire to last. I only needed it everywhere at once.
flavour.unique:dawnwardens_verdict: The night was given its trial. The dawn read the verdict.
flavour.unique:idol_brokkrs_whetstone: Brokkr kept the edge. Sindri kept the fire.
flavour.unique:idol_sindris_coal: It has not gone out since the first forge was lit.
flavour.unique:idol_barrow_kings_tally: Every notch a warrior who still answers the horn.
flavour.unique:idol_thanes_stormglass: Hung over the hall door, it rang before every storm.
flavour.unique:idol_millstone_of_mardoth: In Mardoth they ground the mountain into roads.
flavour.unique:idol_heartstone: Warm in the hand, cold in the chest.
flavour.unique:idol_siege_tally: Count the bolts, count the walls, count the days.
flavour.unique:idol_oathkeepers_spine: It stood in the hall long after the oath that raised it fell.
flavour.unique:drune_barrow_host: The cairn opens; one more answers the horn.
flavour.unique:drune_siege_line: Wind the crank, mark the wall, loose.
flavour.unique:drune_copper_vein: Strike the vein and the whole seam sings.
flavour.unique:drune_turning_mill: The millstone never stops; neither do you.
flavour.unique:drune_unbroken_ward: Carved at the gate that never fell.
flavour.unique:drune_forge_tongue: Every blow leaves the forge still burning.
flavour.unique:drune_hallowed_vigil: The hall's last keeper prayed until the floor itself burned holy.
flavour.unique:drune_long_winter: Under the mountain the winter never ended. It only waited for a door.
flavour.unique:drune_grave_rot: Carved in a barrow wall. The rot still remembers the shape.
flavour.unique:drune_snare_line: Every tunnel had one. Nobody ever saw it twice.
flavour.unique:idol_vigil_ember: A coal from the hall's last vigil. It still keeps the hour.
flavour.unique:idol_rimeglass: Ice from a pass that never thawed, cut into a lens.
flavour.unique:idol_engineers_gear: The last gear of the last engine. It turns on its own.
flavour.unique:core_oathwardens_chain: He held the sky with it. When the oath broke, he let go.
flavour.unique:core_link_of_the_sundered_chain: One link of the chain that bound the sky. It still pulls toward the next.
flavour.unique:drune_falling_sky: Carved on the last island before it fell. The sky never stopped falling after.
flavour.unique:deep_forged_band: Hammered in the Deep Forge, where the dwarves sealed their oaths in stone.
flavour.unique:deep_forged_torc: The forge-masters wore one rune at the throat. They said it listened.
flavour.unique:deepwarden_lantern: The wardens carried one light into the Deep. It never went out. They did.
flavour.unique:gravecut: Forged below the last stair, where the oath was buried and the blade was not.
flavour.unique:ossuary_stride: Every step down there is on someone. These remember each one.
flavour.unique:the_unspoken_pair: A kensei never named his cuts. The dead in the Catacombs learned them anyway.
flavour.unique:sheathbreaker_grips: Drawn, struck, sheathed. The floor of the Deep remembers the third sound longest.
flavour.unique:oathborn_crown_of_the_unbroken: Every king who wore it kept his word. There were not many.
flavour.unique:oathborn_heart_of_the_rupture: The Rupture had one heart. Someone took it.
flavour.unique:oathborn_stride_of_the_first_oath: The first oath was a promise to keep walking.
flavour.unique:mainspring_maul: Wind it once and it swings forever. The gnome who wound it is still running.
flavour.unique:overclock_coil: Rated for one charge. It has never been asked to stop at one.
flavour.unique:cogwright_grip: Brass knuckles in the most literal sense. Every finger has a gear, and every gear has an opinion.
flavour.unique:brass_heart_locket: It ticks where a heart would beat. Wearers stop noticing which one is theirs.
flavour.unique:tickstep_treads: Each step is exactly as long as the last. The mountain learned the rhythm and started to listen.
flavour.unique:pinnacle_void_crown: It ate the stars one oath at a time. The last one, it wore.
flavour.unique:pinnacle_tyrant_brand: Massad burned for a year. He carried the brand that lit it.
flavour.unique:pinnacle_regent_signet: Kabar paid its tithe in blood. The ring remembers every drop.
flavour.unique:pinnacle_jarl_oathring: He kept his oath when the north broke theirs. It held him up.
flavour.unique:veinwrit_grips: One cut is a warning. A hundred is a sentence.
flavour.unique:the_red_harvest: The field was reaped at dusk. Nothing in it stood up again.
flavour.unique:dawnward_bulwark: Hold the line until the sun comes up. It always comes up.
flavour.unique:facebreaker: Steel is a crutch. Bone remembers every blow.
flavour.unique:dreadcrown: Three griefs on one brow. It never asks which you meant.
flavour.unique:the_unyielding_vow: They broke the gate, the wall and the king. The vow stood there and waited for them.
flavour.unique:the_patient_bastion: Every blow it turned away, it remembered. Then it gave them back.
flavour.unique:the_heartwood_girdle: The old oak does not dodge the storm. It is simply too alive to fall.
flavour.unique:crown_of_the_quiet_ward: The loudest spell in the tower was cast by the mage nobody could touch.
flavour.unique:windwrit_treads: The arrow arrived exactly where she had been.
flavour.unique:the_oathkeepers_stand: Plant your feet. Every blow you land is another stone in the wall.
flavour.unique:stormwake_treads: The road behind it never stops crackling.
flavour.unique:the_third_thunder: The first two are a warning. The third is the answer.
flavour.unique:the_long_storm: Cast once at dawn. Still raining at dusk.
flavour.unique:kingbreaker_primal: Crowns are only metal. Metal bends.
flavour.unique:gravesong_primal: It hums when something dies. The dead hum back.
flavour.unique:gravecleaver_primal: It never learned the difference between a foe and a recruit.
flavour.unique:tidebreaker_maul_primal: Forged for a giant who wanted the sea to stop. It stopped.
flavour.unique:stormfang_primal: The storm bit the blade once. The blade learned to bite back.
flavour.unique:rimecrown_staff_primal: Winter does not ask the river. It simply stops it.
flavour.unique:cinderwick_primal: I never needed the fire to last. I only needed it everywhere at once.
flavour.rw:maelstrom: The storm turns, and everything near it burns.
flavour.rw:earthbreaker: Strike the earth four times, and the fifth time it answers.
flavour.rw:rams_vow: Lower the shield. Do not stop.
flavour.rw:stormcaller: One bolt asks. The second one answers.
flavour.rw:skyfire: The sky remembers every fire you lit.
flavour.rw:cinderwind: Ash rides the wind further than flame.
flavour.rw:siegeworks: Build the wall of bolts, then stand behind it.
flavour.rw:hailstorm: Every arrow comes down as ice.
flavour.rw:spiderweb: Pull one thread, and the whole web sings.
flavour.rw:petalfall: The blossoms fall where the blade has been.
flavour.rw:whirling_steel: Steel that never lands, never stops.
flavour.rw:hammerfall: The hammers circle wider for the faithful.
flavour.rw:choir: Every voice that falls is answered by two.
flavour.rw:ashen_legion: They march to the pyre, and the pyre marches with them.
flavour.rw:harvest: The field is wide. The scythe is patient.
flavour.rw:plague_wind: What the wind carries, the grave keeps.
flavour.rw:wayfarer: The road is shorter for those who keep walking.
flavour.rw:kindling: A spark is a fortune if you keep it.
flavour.rw:bulwark: Stand. That is the whole of the oath.
flavour.rw:warding: Fire, frost and storm, each one turned aside.
flavour.rw:wellspring: Drink, and the well fills again.
flavour.rw:hoard: The dwarves never counted it. They only kept it.
flavour.rw:sunder: No ward holds against the three.
flavour.rw:oathkeeper: Some oaths are older than the ones who swore them.
flavour.rw:thunderwake: The hammer falls once. The sky answers twice.
flavour.rw:gravebloom: What is buried in ash comes up burning.
flavour.rw:windrider: Never where the blade expected you.
flavour.rw:glacier_oath: The ice keeps every promise made to it.
flavour.rw:ironchoir: The dead sing the hymns the living forgot.
flavour.rw:bladesong: Steel that has learned to sing never forgets the tune.
flavour.rw:starfall: Every arrow a falling star; every star a debt repaid.
flavour.rw:first_light: The first light after the long night belongs to whoever kept watch.
flavour.rw:skybinder: The cloud does not ask where the lightning goes.
flavour.rw:nightshade: Pretty in the hedgerow. Patient in the blood.
flavour.rw:heartseeker: One arrow, drawn slow, loosed once. It already knows where it is going.
flavour.rw:swallowcut: The blade turns in the air like a swallow, and cuts on the way back.
flavour.rw:rimebinder: The frost does not chase you. It waits where you will stand.
flavour.rw:bloodletter: It does not need to cut deep. It only needs to cut again.
flavour.rw:dawnsworn: Raised at first light, and it has not been lowered since.
flavour.rw:emberwake: What it touches keeps burning long after it has gone.
flavour.rw:stormlash: The first strike finds you. The second one already knew where you would be.
flavour.rw:clarion: Every hall it enters already knows its name.
flavour.rw:kindlewatch: Light a fire, and then let it keep the watch.
flavour.rw:stillwater: The lake does not fight the winter. It waits, and holds.
flavour.rw:viperstring: It never needs the second arrow. It only needs the first one, and time.
flavour.rw:oathwall: I kept every blow they gave me. Now I give them back.
flavour.rw:veilward: What cannot touch me cannot stop me.
flavour.rw:red_ouroboros: The serpent bites its tail, and the storm begins again.
flavour.rw:red_thousandfold: Say it once. The ash says it a thousand times.
flavour.rw:red_barrowking: The barrow keeps no one. It lends them back.
flavour.rw:red_engine_deep: Stone raises stone, and the deep is never finished.
flavour.rw:red_long_night: The night is long, and every snare remembers the last.
flavour.rw:red_plaguewyrm: The wyrm does not die. It moves house.
flavour.rw:red_mainspring: Wind it once, and it never stops counting.
flavour.rw:red_skyspear: One spear leaves the hand. The sky returns a hundred.
flavour.rw:red_pyre_kings: Kings were burned on oak. The oak remembers how.
flavour.rw:red_drowned_year: A year under water, and still the cup is full.
flavour.rw:red_sigilbreaker: Break the seal. Break the next. Never stop.
flavour.rw:red_endless_hall: The hall has no end. Neither do you.
flavour.rw:red_orbit_ash: The ash tree turns, and the storm turns with it.
flavour.rw:red_promised_blade: It was promised. It was always going to arrive.
flavour.rw:red_heartwood: Strike the oak, and the oak strikes back.
flavour.rw:red_thousand_hands: A thousand hands draw. None of them are yours.
flavour.rw:red_stormwake: The storm does not strike once. It follows.
flavour.rw:red_crowned_ouroboros: Crowned, the serpent never misses its tail.
flavour.rw:red_crowned_pyre: A crown laid on the pyre burns brightest.

skilldesc.sk:storm_whirl: Hold to spin inside a crackling vortex, moving toward the cursor; lightning lashes everything around you and strikes one enemy every turn.
skilldesc.sk:flame_dash: Teleport a short distance toward the cursor in a burst of flame, leaving a burning path that sears enemies standing in it. Every half second the path deals half the damage shown, for 3 seconds.
skilldesc.sk:winter_orb: Conjure every orb of ice you can hold (one to start, more from passives and gear) by your shoulder for 6 seconds. They hurl icicles at nearby enemies (faster with cast speed and Winter Orb fire rate), then shatter in a frost explosion that chills everything around it. At your orb limit, casting again shatters the oldest orb at once.
skilldesc.sk:storm_brand: Throw a crackling spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.5 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with lightning that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
skilldesc.sk:ember_spark: Throw a smouldering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.8 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with a heavy blow of fire that sets it burning. It never chains to other enemies: it is the spark for the one enemy that will not die. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
skilldesc.sk:rime_spark: Throw a freezing spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.7 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with frost that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump, chilling the whole pack. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
skilldesc.sk:venom_spark: Throw a festering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.4 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host and {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) with venom, a tenth less on each jump, and every strike adds a poison: the longer it crawls, the deeper they rot. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.
skilldesc.sk:thunderfall: Strike three times with your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a staff or wand suits it). The third blow calls lightning down on every enemy in front of you. Its damage is lightning. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.
skilldesc.sk:glacial_shards: Flick {Projectiles} shards of ice from your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a wand or staff suits it). Each bursts into frost on the first enemy it strikes, chilling everything nearby. Its damage is cold. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.
skilldesc.sk:reap: Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide, hungry sweep that cuts everything in front of you.
skilldesc.sk:death_coil: Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a coil of grave-magic that seeks the nearest foe ahead and bursts on it, rotting everything nearby.
skilldesc.sk:summon_skeletons: Raise skeleton warriors from the ground: two, and one more at gem levels 6, 11 and 16 (every 5 gem levels). While you are below level 10 it raises 2 more and costs half the mana, a starter's help that ends at level 10. They follow you and fight until they fall.
skilldesc.sk:summon_skeletal_mage: Raise skeletal mages that keep their distance and hurl bolts of dark magic at your foes: one, two from gem level 9, three from gem level 17. They stay until they fall.
skilldesc.sk:drain_life: Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor with a beam of grave-hunger: it rots while you drink, and the beam forks on to 3 more enemies nearby, each link a tenth weaker. A fifth of the damage comes back to you as life, and your minions drink with you.
skilldesc.sk:vampire_dash: Come apart into mist and bats and gather again a short way toward the cursor. The mist lingers on your path and rots whatever stands in it.
skilldesc.sk:summon_bone_golem: Tear a golem of grave-fire out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it; it burns in the colour of its supports' element. Only one answers at a time. Each golem blesses those near it: the grave golem heals you 1% of your life a second, the flame golem gives your minions 12.5% more damage, the ice golem gives you 31% more armour, the storm golem makes your minions 15% faster, and the venom golem makes enemies take 7.5% more damage. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.
skilldesc.sk:summon_zombie: Drag a zombie up out of the ground: two stand at once, three from gem level 16, four from gem level 24. Zombies stay until they fall, grow with the gem, hit hard and every fourth blow slams the ground round their foe. Supports such as Brutality or Flame make them brutal or burning.
skilldesc.sk:grave_call: Call every minion you have to your side. They come running (those far away step out of the ground beside you) and close in round you, then fight on with 30% more damage, moving and attacking 20% faster, for 4 seconds.
skilldesc.sk:unholy_void: Open a void of unholy energy around you: enemies inside take poison damage twice a second, 70% of the damage shown each time. The void gnaws at you too: 0.9% of your life per second, less with poison resistance, never the last tenth of your life. Press again to close it.
skilldesc.sk:grave_reap: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Thralls that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.
skilldesc.sk:soul_rend: Two heavy chops tear at the soul. Enemies hit are Rent for 4 seconds: your minions deal 10% more damage to them. 30% of its damage is poison.
skilldesc.sk:marrow_lance: Hurl a lance of bone that pierces through the line. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Casters that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.
skilldesc.sk:pyre_burst: Set a fresh corpse near your aim ablaze. It bursts in fire, hitting every enemy around it, and deals 10% of the slain's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as extra fire (20% at gem level 20). Your own fallen minions count as corpses. With no corpse there, your nearest minion is sacrificed instead.
skilldesc.sk:hammer_blow: Your mace's basic attack, no mana cost. A heavy blow at the enemy in front of you.
skilldesc.sk:holy_slash: A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you. Your mace's mana skill; Hammer Blow is its free attack.
skilldesc.sk:judgement: Raise your weapon to the sky: a moment later bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another, each exploding on impact. {Projectiles} {Projectiles}|plural(one=bolt,other=bolts); one more at gem levels 10 and 20. The bolts are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them. Judgement is a Skyfall skill: every Skyfall line reaches it, and second fall lines (Twice Judged, Twice-Fallen Sky) drop the sky again where each bolt lands (each enemy takes one second fall per cast).
skilldesc.sk:orbiting_hammers: Turn on a ring of {OrbitCount} spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back again, smashing everything it passes. It drains 6 mana a second while it spins (more with supports); press again to turn it off, and it stops when your mana runs out. One more hammer at gem levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20; from five hammers a second, outer ring turns the other way and pulses out as the inner one comes in. Hammerstorm empowers it.
skilldesc.sk:hammerstorm: Swear the hammers to the storm: for 6 seconds your spinning hammers turn half again as fast, reach 35% farther, hit 40% harder and three more hammers join them in a second ring. If no hammers are spinning, it calls them.
skilldesc.sk:consecrated_ground: Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you for 5 seconds. Enemies on it burn with holy light, are slowed, take 20% more damage from every hit and are struck critically more often (+8% chance); you regenerate 2% of your life per second while you stand on it.
skilldesc.sk:holy_charge: Charge behind your shield toward the cursor and bash the first enemy in your path, stunning it. Where the charge ends, holy light burns the ground for 2 seconds, slowing enemies and healing you. The bash deals the full damage shown; the holy light deals 35% of it every half second. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.
skilldesc.sk:summon_holy_elemental: Call down a Holy Elemental of living light. It fights at your side, smashing your foes with blows of holy light that strike everything around them, until it is destroyed. A second elemental answers at gem level 10. Its light shelters you: within 9 metres of it you have +6% chance to block and regenerate 0.5% of your life a second. Shared Light: past 4 elementals, each deals 4% less per extra elemental standing (12: 32% less each). The army never shrinks, only the blow each one lands.
skilldesc.sk:pyre_of_faith: Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn twice a second for fire damage that grows with your maximum life. The pyre burns you too: 6% of your life per second, a quarter of that at 75% fire resistance, never the last tenth of your life: you need life regeneration. Press again to put it out. Its burn is a Fire spell hit: Fire, Spell, Area and Holy damage scale it; Burning damage modifiers scale Ignites, not the pyre.
skilldesc.sk:hallowed_slam: Bring your weapon down on the ground in front of you. Where it lands the ground is hallowed for 3 seconds, one new patch a second: enemies on it burn for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second and take 8% more damage from every hit, and you regain life while you stand in it.
skilldesc.sk:shield_throw: Hurl your shield at the enemy in front of you. It rings off the first enemy it strikes into the next, up to 3 more times, a little weaker at every leap. A Shield skill: while you hold a shield it gains 1% increased damage per 5 armour, evasion and energy shield on that shield, and Shield skill bonuses apply. Without a shield it keeps its full base damage.
skilldesc.sk:quick_shot: Loose an arrow at the target. Free to use.
skilldesc.sk:power_shot: Draw the bow to its full and loose a heavy arrow that pierces every enemy in its path.
skilldesc.sk:split_shot: Loose a fan of {Projectiles} arrows. Each enemy is struck by one arrow. One more arrow at gem levels 8 and 16.
skilldesc.sk:arrow_rain: Fire a volley into the sky. A moment later it rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times. Aimed at an enemy, the volley leads it: it falls where that enemy will be when the arrows land.
skilldesc.sk:wind_vault: Vault toward the cursor on a gust of wind (or back, away from it, when the cursor is close), shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. The damage shown is a full hit: each landing arrow deals 60% of it and the gust 15%. Cancels attacks. The arrows are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them.
skilldesc.sk:lightning_arrow: Loose an arrow charged with lightning. Half its physical damage is converted to lightning. When it strikes an enemy, lightning leaps from it to {Chains} more {Chains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) for 72% of the hit, a tenth less on each jump. The first enemy takes the full damage shown. With no other enemy in reach, the leaps it cannot make come back into that enemy as one extra strike, so a lone boss takes about 29% more.
skilldesc.sk:summon_ballista: Plant a ballista where you aim (up to 9 metres away) that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support and the passive tree add more, and every one you add counts. Supports on this gem change its bolts. Each bolt pierces one enemy; with Chain or Fork linked it chains or forks at its first enemy instead.
skilldesc.sk:caustic_arrow: Loose a rotten arrow that bursts into a caustic cloud where it strikes, one new cloud a second. The cloud lingers for 3 seconds and poisons every enemy inside for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second. 60% of its damage is poison.
skilldesc.sk:fuse_arrow: Loose an arrow with a burning fuse. It bursts in fire where it strikes, hitting every enemy around the target. 60% of its damage is fire.
skilldesc.sk:twin_cuts: Your blades' basic attack, no mana cost. A quick cut with each blade at the enemy in front of you.
skilldesc.sk:flurry: A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last one is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back. Your blades' mana skill; Twin Cuts is their free attack.
skilldesc.sk:iaido_thrust: Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line. A moment later you sheathe and they bleed for a second cut. The dash cut deals the full damage shown, the sheathe cut 38% of it. Every enemy you cut stays marked for 5 seconds, and each new cut on a marked enemy adds 25% of that cut to its mark: Sheathe makes them burst. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.
skilldesc.sk:crescent_slash: A heavy cross cut with both blades. The cut flies on as a crescent wave that slices through every enemy on its line.
skilldesc.sk:shuriken_fan: Flick a fan of {Projectiles} spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through {Pierce} {Pierce}|plural(one=foe,other=foes) before it stops. One more at gem levels 10 and 18.
skilldesc.sk:blade_vortex: {OrbitCount} spectral {OrbitCount}|plural(one=blade joins,other=blades join) a ring that circles you for 6 seconds, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Cast again to add more: up to {OrbitMax} blades. While it is on your bar, every basic attack that lands adds a blade.
skilldesc.sk:thousand_cuts: Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group around you five times, cutting everything near each one. The last cut is the heaviest. You end beside the last group you cut. Counts as a Movement skill and as a dash: movement supports, passives, items and Echo Cut apply (Echo Cut adds one more cut where you end). It is still a melee attack.
skilldesc.sk:sheathe: Sheathe your blades with a click. Every enemy your Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first, for 160% of its mark, and half of that to everything around it. A mark is the strongest Iaido cut on that enemy plus 25% of every other cut it took while marked, so thrust through it a few times before you sheathe. Needs marks: cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.
skilldesc.sk:viper_fang: Three quick poisoned stabs at the enemy in front of you. Most of their damage is poison, and every stab lays a stack of poison that keeps eating at the enemy after you move on.
skilldesc.sk:moonfall: Leap to the cursor and fall on the enemies there with both blades. As you sheathe them a moment later, every enemy you struck is cut again for half the damage. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.
skilldesc.sk:cyclone: Hold to spin with your weapon outstretched, moving toward the cursor through enemies and cutting everything around you. Costs mana while you spin.
skilldesc.sk:shield_charge: Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival: the blast hits everything around you. Each enemy the blast catches gives back 1.5 mana. Almost no cooldown, chain it from pack to pack.
skilldesc.sk:earthshatter: Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor, hitting everything on its line. Enemies it kills leave a spike of rock that shatters a moment later, hitting those around it.
skilldesc.sk:rending_slam: Bring a two-handed weapon down so hard the ground rends: a shock runs out in a straight line toward the cursor, hitting every enemy on it. Your body is in the blow: 4% of your maximum life joins the weapon's base damage. No cooldown.
skilldesc.sk:wheeling_axe: Hurl a spinning axe toward the cursor. It cuts through every enemy in its path, then wheels back to your hand and cuts them again on the way.
skilldesc.sk:vow_of_clarity: Swear a Vow of clear thought: you regenerate mana. Reserves a small, flat amount of mana while sworn (it fits an early mana pool). Press again to break it (Vowbreak): for 4 seconds your skills cost no mana, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds and you are Forsworn.
skilldesc.sk:vow_of_vigor: Swear a Vow of the living body: you regenerate life, and your attacks gain a little mana on hit. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Vowbreak: heal a quarter of your life at once and regenerate far faster for 4 seconds.
skilldesc.sk:woe_of_withering: Lay a Woe on every enemy in an area: they take more Poison damage, more damage of every kind and move slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it: the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread (+3% Woe effect per Dread, up to 20). An enemy that dies under it spreads the Woe to 2 nearby enemies. Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
skilldesc.sk:toll_of_dread: Ring the toll: every Woe in an area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, 10% more per Dread it carried.
skilldesc.sk:death_sentence: Sentence one enemy: it takes 25% more damage from everything. Only one enemy can be Sentenced; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (32.5% more damage taken).
skilldesc.sk:jarls_roar: A war cry of the old jarls: enemies around you turn on you, and you gain a Resolve charge for each enemy it reaches (up to 3). Resolve: 6% reduced physical damage taken and +6% to elemental resistances per charge.
skilldesc.sk:war_banner_skill: Plant your War Banner where you aim (up to 8 metres away); use it again to move it. Enemies within 6 metres of the banner take 6% more damage. Every enemy that dies near it adds a Valour (+0.5% more, up to 20); a Rare, Unique or Guardian fighting near it adds one every 2 seconds. Moving the banner keeps half its Valour. Walk away and it falls. An enemy under both your banner and your Hunter's Marks takes only the stronger of the two.
skilldesc.sk:woe_of_cinders: Lay a Woe of Cinders on every enemy in an area: its Fire resistance falls by 20. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
skilldesc.sk:woe_of_rime: Lay a Woe of Rime on every enemy in an area: its Cold resistance falls by 20 and it moves 10% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
skilldesc.sk:woe_of_the_tempest: Lay a Woe of the Tempest on every enemy in an area: its Lightning resistance falls by 20. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
skilldesc.sk:woe_of_sundering: Lay a Woe of Sundering on every enemy in an area: it takes 20% more Physical damage. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
skilldesc.sk:woe_of_faltering: Lay a Woe of Faltering on every enemy in an area: its hits deal 20% less damage and it moves 20% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.
skilldesc.sk:herald_of_embers: Swear a Herald of fire: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra fire damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills burst into flame: 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as fire damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Fire and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life. A skill linked to Brutality gains nothing from it (Brutality deals no elemental damage).
skilldesc.sk:herald_of_rime: Swear a Herald of cold: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra cold damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills shatter: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as cold damage within 3 metres (it chills). Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Cold and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life. A skill linked to Brutality gains nothing from it (Brutality deals no elemental damage).
skilldesc.sk:herald_of_storms: Swear a Herald of lightning: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra lightning damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills arc to the 3 nearest enemies within 5 metres: 8% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as lightning damage. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Lightning and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life. A skill linked to Brutality gains nothing from it (Brutality deals no elemental damage).
skilldesc.sk:herald_of_rot: Swear a Herald of poison: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra poison damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills burst into rot: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as poison damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Poison damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life.
skilldesc.sk:vow_of_the_bulwark: Swear a Vow against the elements and venom: +10% to fire, cold, lightning and poison resistances at gem level 1, +19.5% at 20 (never past your maximum). Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the resistances are 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
skilldesc.sk:vow_of_iron: Swear a Vow of iron: 20% more Armour at gem level 1, 29.5% at 20. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Armour bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 74% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
skilldesc.sk:vow_of_the_wind: Swear a Vow of the wind: 20% more Evasion at gem level 1, 29.5% at 20. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Evasion bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 74% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.
skilldesc.sk:vow_of_warding: Swear a Vow of warding: 20% more Energy Shield and 20% faster Energy Shield recharge at gem level 1, 29.5% more and 39% faster at 20. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): both bonuses are 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.

supportdesc.sup:chain: Chains 2 additional times, each time to another enemy (never the same one twice): strong in packs, adds nothing against a lone boss. Each jump hits 8% harder than the last, so a full chain hits the last enemies hardest. 5% less damage. A projectile that still pierces flies on first and chains once its pierce runs out (a Ballista bolt chains at its first enemy). A Spark's leaps are not projectiles: they gain the extra leaps, but each leap still loses a tenth of its damage.
supportdesc.sup:multiple_projectiles: Fires 2 additional projectiles in a fan. 15% less damage. Each enemy is hit by one projectile per cast; the extras hit the pack behind.
supportdesc.sup:concentrated: 30% less area of effect. 35% more damage.
supportdesc.sup:added_lightning: Adds 1 to 6 lightning damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage, and +10% chance to Shock.
supportdesc.sup:added_poison: Adds 1 to 6 poison damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. The skill's poison damage penetrates 10% poison resistance. Supports Attack and Spell skills: any hit with poison damage can poison. Supported skills' poisons, bleeds and ignites deal 40% less damage. On a minion skill its minions' hits carry it at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:added_fire: Spells gain 2 to 5 fire damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage (not a summon's minions). Every skill gains 30% of its physical damage as extra fire damage: it counts the physical left after conversion, so it adds less with Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked.
supportdesc.sup:elemental_focus: 30% more elemental damage. Damage converted to Fire, Cold or Lightning (Flame, Ice, Lightning) counts as elemental too.
supportdesc.sup:toxic_focus: 25% more poison damage: poison hits and the poisons they apply. Damage converted to Poison (Venom) counts as poison too.
supportdesc.sup:faster_casting: 25% more cast speed. On a summon of casters (Skeletal Mage): they cast 25% faster.
supportdesc.sup:faster_attacks: 25% more attack speed. On a summon: its minions attack 25% faster.
supportdesc.sup:penetration: Hits ignore 20% of enemy elemental resistance.
supportdesc.sup:life_leech: 1.5% of the damage the skill deals is leeched as life, and it deals 15% more damage while you are leeching (below full life).
supportdesc.sup:brutality: 50% more physical damage, and attacks get another 7.4% more on top (about 61% in all). Minions get the 50%. Deals no elemental damage. Linked with Lightning, Flame or Ice, the converted share is lost. Heralds of Embers, Rime and Storms add nothing to it (their extra damage is elemental); Herald of Rot still does.
supportdesc.sup:pierce: Projectiles pierce 2 additional targets. 10% less damage.
supportdesc.sup:spell_echo: The spell repeats once. 15% less damage. 10% less cast speed. On a channel it adds an echo pulse every 2nd tick at 90% of the hit. An echoed curse is 20% stronger and an echoed war cry's Resolve lasts 1 second longer. Never repeats a dash, a Vow, a toggle like Orbiting Hammers or a spell a trigger casts, and a triggered cast pays none of its price (a Spark still gains its extra spark body). Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
supportdesc.sup:melee_physical: 40% more melee physical damage. 10% less attack speed. Works on melee minions. It scales only the physical left after conversion.
supportdesc.sup:controlled_destruction: 40% more spell damage. -40% to Critical Strike Multiplier. 10% less cast speed.
supportdesc.sup:bloodbound: The linked skill costs life instead of mana (20% more cost) and deals 10% more damage, another 10% more while you are below half your life. The classic way to keep a channel running on an empty mana pool: pair it with Siphon or Vow of Vigor.
supportdesc.sup:siphon: 2% of the linked skill's damage is leeched as life; attacks also leech 1% as mana. A totem's hits leech at 30% of that.
supportdesc.sup:tithe: Every hit of the linked skill returns 2 mana plus 0.4% of your maximum mana (attacks) and every kill 6 mana plus 2% of your maximum mana (spells, attacks and the kills of a linked summon's minions). On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) the linked skill takes returns its kill mana.
supportdesc.sup:woebringer: The linked Woe becomes an aura around you: while sworn it reserves 30% of your mana and lays the Woe on every enemy within 4.5 metres, more with area size on the Woe (Dread grows while they stay in it). Press the skill again to end it.
supportdesc.sup:pass_sentence: When the Sentenced enemy dies, the Sentence passes to the nearest rare or unique enemy (else the nearest enemy) within 10 metres.
supportdesc.sup:gather_fury: Kills with the linked skill grant a Fury charge (at most one every half second). Fury: 4% more damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed per charge. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the charge. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) the linked skill takes counts as a kill.
supportdesc.sup:bloodlust_support: Each kill with the linked skill grants 1 stack of Bloodlust: 0.6% more damage for each stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the stack.
supportdesc.sup:war_banner_support: Retired: the War Banner is now a skill gem of its own. Any War Banner support you had became the War Banner skill gem.
supportdesc.sup:hunters_mark_support: Each hit with the linked skill puts 1 Hunter's Mark on the enemy: it takes 1.4% more damage for each Mark, up to 10, twice as many on a Guardian or a Unique. The Marks fall off 3 seconds after your last hit, so keep shooting. Marks and your War Banner do not add up: an enemy takes the stronger of the two. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:woe_bearer: The linked Woe is borne by your blows: every enemy your hits strike takes it too, while it has room for another Woe (it never replaces one). The Woe can still be cast. Two Woe Bearers work at once.
supportdesc.sup:totem_support: The spell is no longer cast by you: casting places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells can become a totem (not Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or any Spark). Spell Echo and other spell repeats also echo the totem's casts, each echo dealing 20% less damage (a totem's pace ignores cast speed). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's casts. 35% less damage. For bow skills, use Arrow Totem.
supportdesc.sup:arrow_totem: The bow skill is no longer fired by you: firing places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that fires it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only bow skills that shoot arrows can become a totem (not Rain of Arrows, Wind Vault or the Ballista). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's shots, and Multiple Totems adds more totems. 35% less damage.
supportdesc.sup:multiple_totems: You may have 1 additional totem or ballista of the supported skill at once, and it recovers 20% faster. Gem levels never add totems; the passive tree and items can add more. 20% less damage. All your skills together stand at most 6 Ballistas and 10 Totems. Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 80% of one's damage, and each past the sixth adds 20%.
supportdesc.sup:bone_guard: Minions from the supported skill stay close and take on what comes at you. They have 20% more life, 50% more armour and regenerate 2.5% of their life per second. While one stands within 9 metres, you have 30% more armour plus 10 armour per level, and regenerate 1% of your life per second.
supportdesc.sup:ravening_host: Minions from the supported skill range ahead of you and hunt, engaging enemies 50% farther away. They deal 25% more damage and move, attack and cast 15% faster.
supportdesc.sup:zap_support: Turns the skill to lightning: 60% of Physical, Fire and Cold damage is converted to Lightning (Poison at half: 30%). Hits shock with 30% increased effect of Shock, and its Shocks stack: 1 more Shock can sit on an enemy. A spinning attack calls lightning down from the sky onto the enemies it cuts. (Not the Zap spell: Zap is a skill gem of its own.) Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.
supportdesc.sup:flame_support: 60% of Physical, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Fire (Poison at half: 30%). Hits ignite. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.
supportdesc.sup:ice_support: 60% of Physical, Fire and Lightning damage is converted to Cold (Poison at half: 30%). Hits chill; chilled kills shatter. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.
supportdesc.sup:venom_support: 60% of Physical, Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Poison. +25% chance to Poison. Poison hits ignore 15% of Poison resistance. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.
supportdesc.sup:skyfall: The skill strikes from the sky at its target instead of travelling (every chain target is struck from above; a bow's arrows drop point-first). A Nova falls on its target up to 9 metres away and blooms there. On Earthshatter a meteor of the slam's element falls at the end of the fissure. Only Projectile, Chain, Brand and Nova spells (every Spark), projectile attacks (not Crescent Slash's wave) and the Ballista's volley can fall; each enemy is struck once per use. Spells deal 20% more damage. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain, Trap or Totem also socketed, the first one socketed is used (a Totem or Trap always places it) and Skyfall adds only its damage. Winter Orb and Orbiting Hammers keep circling.
supportdesc.sup:tether: Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 other enemies within 5 metres for 3 seconds; linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second.
supportdesc.sup:swift_step: The movement skill has a 40% shorter cooldown and deals 20% more damage.
supportdesc.sup:channel_conduit: While you channel, your linked spell casts itself at the nearest enemy every 0.5 seconds for half its mana cost, with this skill's other supports. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. 30% more channelling cost. Works with Cyclone and every channelled attack. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.
supportdesc.sup:honed_edge: +1% to base Critical Strike Chance and 80% increased Critical Strike Chance. Best on a build that already raises its critical strikes. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:deathblow: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier: critical strikes hit much harder. Best with Honed Edge or other critical strike chance. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:orbit: The skill's projectiles first circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy (a bow's arrows circle nose-first). Spells gain +1 projectile. Not on a skill that already circles you, such as Orbiting Hammers or Winter Orb (each keeps its own ring), and not on Crescent Slash's wave. Every projectile circles, up to 24 at once. Every projectile strikes; one sent at an enemy this cast already struck deals 75% less damage (an arrow or thrown blade 90% less: spread them over a pack). A skill takes one shape: Orbit keeps it circling even with Meteor Lore (the fall gives way), and with another shape gem socketed the first one socketed is used.
supportdesc.sup:channel_mastery: Up to 25% more damage, ramping in over the first second of channelling. 20% less channelling cost.
supportdesc.sup:minion_damage: Minions from the supported skill deal 40% more damage.
supportdesc.sup:minion_life: Minions from the supported skill have 60% more life.
supportdesc.sup:minion_speed: Minions from the supported skill move, attack and cast 25% faster.
supportdesc.sup:fork: Projectiles fork into two on hitting an enemy: each flies on to either side for 70% of the hit. A projectile that still pierces forks once its pierce runs out; Shuriken Fan and melee waves fork at their first enemy and fly on, and a Ballista bolt forks at its first enemy.
supportdesc.sup:rain_support: The projectiles no longer fly: they go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times (four times with 4 or more projectiles). 30% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down on its target twice. Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or Crescent Slash's wave: they cannot rain.
supportdesc.sup:trap_support: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds). Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash or the Storm, Rime and Venom Sparks: they cannot be thrown. It is live the moment it lands and goes off the instant an enemy comes within 4 metres; its first strike deals 30% more damage, then it re-arms about a second later (sooner with faster re-arm). It also fits a bow Ballista. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby. 35% more damage. Your Traps out at once share their damage: each Trap past the first adds 90% of a Trap's damage, and each past your sixth (all your Trap skills count) adds 40%; an Attack a Trap throws counts its Effectiveness past 800% at 25% (Wheeling Axe, Shield Throw and Glacial Shards hit that hard by hand).
supportdesc.sup:afterimage: Supported melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing. 20% less damage. On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
supportdesc.sup:affliction_support: +35% chance to Ignite and +35% chance to Poison. 50% increased Burning and Poison damage. 10% less damage with hits.
supportdesc.sup:stormfrost_support: +25% chance to Shock and 50% increased effect of Shock. Cold hits build up Freeze 60% faster, and its Lightning damage is 15% more against Chilled or Frozen enemies.
supportdesc.sup:repeat_support: Bow skills fire 1 more time, a moment later (a Ballista fires each bolt twice). Channelled skills strike 1 more time inside each pulse. 40% less damage. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
supportdesc.sup:cast_on_crit: When one of your attacks lands a critical hit, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the enemy struck, for 50% of its mana cost. Spells that cast themselves this way take turns: at most one of them every 0.3 seconds. The triggered spell deals 25% less damage. In an attack or a spell, its crits cast the spell dropped on its link. On top of that, every Cast on Crit you have shares one clock: at most one cast every 0.15 seconds, taking turns, so one critical hit casts one spell; with nothing linked, the attack strikes by itself when your other attacks crit, at most once every 0.75 seconds for all such attacks, for a further 44% less damage (a Rain drops one wave, and Repeat, Afterimage or Multistrike never repeat it). Movement skills, Blade Vortex, Sheathe, channels, auras and Heralds never cast or strike by themselves: link a spell to them. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second. A totem's or ballista's crit casts only the spell on its own link, never your other Cast on Crit spells.
supportdesc.sup:cast_when_hit: Each time you have taken damage equal to 10% of your maximum life, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the attacker, at most once every 0.5 seconds, for 50% of its mana cost. The triggered spell deals 10% less damage. In an attack, or to cast another spell, drop a spell on its link. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second.
supportdesc.sup:cast_on_minion_death: When a minion from this skill dies, your linked spell casts itself at the enemy nearest to where it fell, at most once per second, for 50% of its mana cost and with this skill's other supports. The linked spell deals 10% less damage. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. One link per skill: the first linking support socketed works. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.
supportdesc.sup:rend: Physical hits of this skill have a 50% chance to cause Bleeding: 50% of the hit's physical damage each second for 4 seconds (the strongest bleed holds; 50% more while the enemy moves). 60% more Bleeding damage. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:deep_wounds: +40% to Damage over Time Multiplier for this skill: its Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal 40% more damage. Hits are unchanged. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:living_storm: This skill's Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 75% more damage taken. +25% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:contagion_flame: When an enemy this skill ignited dies, its Ignite spreads (100% chance) to enemies within 4.5 metres. While it burns, every second it also passes its Ignite to the nearest enemy within 3 metres that burns less. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:shatter: Chilled or Frozen enemies this skill kills shatter: 12% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 metres, chilling them, and an enemy the burst kills shatters in turn. 20% increased effect of Chill. On a minion skill it works at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:melee_splash: Every blow splashes: enemies within 2 metres of each enemy struck take 55% of the blow's damage (once per blow). 10% less damage. Works on minions: their blows splash too.
supportdesc.sup:multistrike: The melee attack strikes 3 times: it repeats 2 more times and every strike deals 48% of the damage (52% less). On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Works on minions: each of their blows strikes 2 more times. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.
supportdesc.sup:maim: Hits Maim the enemy for 4 seconds: it moves 30% slower and takes 20% more Physical damage from you, your minions and your allies. 8% more Physical damage. Works on minions. Only the Physical part counts: damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked) gains nothing from Maim.
supportdesc.sup:ruthless: Every third blow is a Ruthless blow: 60% more Physical damage and a heavy, bloody impact. Works on minions: every third blow of each minion.
supportdesc.sup:executioner: 35% more damage against enemies below half their life, and hits kill enemies left below 10% of their life (Guardians too). Works with bows and on minions.
supportdesc.sup:vicious_projectiles: 40% more Physical damage with projectiles, 10% less attack speed. Only the Physical part counts: it adds nothing to damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked). On a summon it fits minions that shoot, at half strength.
supportdesc.sup:added_cold: Adds 3 to 4 cold damage to spells and attacks, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. Steadier than Added Lightning (1 to 6) for the same average: it chills where Added Lightning shocks.
supportdesc.sup:chain_detonation: Supports skills thrown as Traps. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby, one after another. Traps set each other off at 100% increased distance, and each Trap further down the chain deals 8% more damage. +1 to the maximum number of Traps.
supportdesc.sup:volatile_dead: Minions from the supported skill explode where they fall: when killed, when their time runs out, or when a new cast replaces them past your limit. Each blast deals Fire Damage in 3 metres equal to 20% of the minion's maximum Life plus 50% of its hit damage. Recast at your limit to detonate your oldest minions.
supportdesc.sup:funeral_pyre: Enemies killed by the supported skill's hits burst into flame where they fall, dealing Fire Damage in 2.5 metres equal to 15% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life). The burst is not the skill's hit, so what it kills does not burst again.
supportdesc.sup:inspiration: The linked skill costs 25% less. No damage of its own: it keeps a spammed spell or attack firing.
supportdesc.sup:economical_vow: The linked Vow or Herald reserves 20% less of your pool (a Herald 25% to 20%). Room for one more Vow or a bigger mana pool for your spells.
supportdesc.sup:wide_burst: The linked Herald's kill effect reaches 60% further: Embers and Rot burst over 4 metres, Rime shatters over 4.8 metres, Storms arcs to enemies within 8 metres. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.
supportdesc.sup:ruinous_herald: The linked Herald's kill effect deals 60% more damage (Embers 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life becomes 19.2%). Kills that chain into kills: a clear speed pick. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.
supportdesc.sup:lingering_woe: The linked Woe builds Dread 50% faster and lasts 50% longer on every enemy it touches (cast, channelled, borne by Woe Bearer or sworn with Woebringer).
supportdesc.sup:dawnbringer: Every third hit of the linked Holy attack calls a pillar of dawn on the enemy, dealing 50% of the hit as Fire Damage (at most once a second on the same enemy). For Holy Slash, Hallowed Slam, Holy Charge and Shield Throw; it stacks with the Dawnward Bulwark and Radiant Crusade, each counts its own hits.
supportdesc.sup:grave_conscription: Enemies killed by the linked attack have a 25% chance to rise as one of your Zombies while you have fewer than 4 (at most once every half second). Your minion damage and life apply to them, and if you also have Raise Zombie, its minion supports do too. Any attack build can grow a small horde.
supportdesc.sup:venom_bloom: Every fourth hit of the linked Poison attack bursts in venom: enemies within 2.5 metres take 45% of the hit as Poison Damage (at most once every 0.2 seconds, each enemy at most once every 0.5 seconds). For Gravereap, Soul Rend and Marrow Lance: a pack clear for poison melee.
supportdesc.sup:sanctified_support: Turns the linked Holy attack to holy light: 60% of its Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Physical (Poison at half: 30%), so added elemental damage from your gear feeds your Physical bonuses, and it deals 15% more Physical Damage. The Paladin's answer to Zap, Flame, Ice and Venom; pairs with Brutality.
supportdesc.sup:whirling_host: The linked Orbit skill adds one more blade or hammer with each cast and its ring holds one more (Blade Vortex 9 instead of 8, Orbiting Hammers 4 instead of 3), each dealing 15% less damage. A wider, fuller ring that fills faster and catches more of the pack.
supportdesc.sup:conjured_pair: The linked Orb skill keeps one more orb at a time (Winter Orb: two orbs by your shoulders, both formed by one cast), each dealing 35% less damage. Twice the icicles over twice the ground: more coverage, a little more damage in all.
supportdesc.sup:rampart_strike: The linked Shield attack deals 0.8% more damage for every 1% chance to block you have (at 50% block: 40% more, at 75%: 60% more). Shield Charge, Holy Charge and Shield Throw: the block you build to live now hits back.
supportdesc.sup:deepened_woe: Every line of the linked Woe is 25% stronger: the damage it makes enemies take, the resistance it lowers, the damage they deal less and its slow. The Woe's own build, for when one Woe carries the whole party.
supportdesc.sup:tempered_aura: The linked damaging aura gnaws 40% less of your life (Unholy Void 0.9% to 0.54% a second, Pyre of Faith 6% to 3.6%). Stand in the fire longer: the support for life stacking aura builds.
supportdesc.sup:spreading_pyre: The linked corpse skill's fire leaps on to 2 more fresh corpses, one after another, each within the burst's radius of the last. Each leap bursts for its own corpse's life and deals 60% of the leap before it (Pyre Burst at gem 20: 10% of the slain's life, then 6%, then 3.6%). Corpses its own fire makes can carry it on: a pack goes up like kindling.
supportdesc.sup:defiant_roar: The linked war cry also grants a Fury charge for each Resolve charge it grants (Jarl's Roar into 3 enemies: 3 Resolve and 3 Fury), and that Resolve lasts 50% longer (10 s to 15 s). Fury: 4% more damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each. The roar that holds the line now pays you to stand in it.
supportdesc.sup:rallying_standard: The linked War Banner lands with 5 Valour already raised, keeps all of its Valour when you move it (not half), and holds up to 10 more (20 to 30). Each Valour is 0.5% more damage taken by enemies near it: a banner you can carry from pack to pack and plant straight into a Guardian fight.
supportdesc.sup:focused_volley: The linked bow skill fires 1 more arrow, and all its arrows fly on one line at your target, each with its own hit, so one enemy can take every arrow. Each arrow after the first deals 60% of the one before it (2 arrows: 100% + 60%; 4 arrows: 100% + 60% + 36% + 22%), and the skill deals 15% less damage. A Guardian killer: you give up the spread. Arrows you shoot yourself only (not a trap, totem or rain).
supportdesc.sup:killer_instinct: Your linked minions strike for the throat: +4% to their base critical strike chance, 100% increased critical strike chance and +40% to critical strike multiplier. The crit support minion builds never had: your tree's minion and critical strike lines now have something to scale.
supportdesc.sup:ironclad_fury: The linked skill deals 2% more damage per 1,000 Armour, 1.5% more per 1,000 Evasion, 3.5% more per 1,000 maximum Energy Shield and 2.5% more per 1,000 maximum Life you have. Past 12,000 Armour or Evasion, 6,000 Energy Shield or 5,000 Life each 1,000 counts a quarter. At 16,000 Armour and 8,000 Life: 40% more. It adds into the same damage engine as the passive tree's lines that pay your defences. Any attack or spell, totems and traps too: the walls you built now hit back.

guardianlore.g:mire_colossus: Risen from the Kabarian mire where the kingdom of El Anure drowned.
guardianlore.g:heartwood_ancient: Its roots drank from the springs of Myrh before the Oath was broken.
guardianlore.g:mountain_king: He held Harmon Fort until the ice closed the pass behind him.
guardianlore.g:crystal_matriarch: Her brood grew fat on the cold light of the Underrealm.
guardianlore.g:brass_colossus: Forged in the Titanium Quarry of Mardoth, and never told to stop.
guardianlore.g:void_archon: A splinter of the first rupture, still looking for the way home.
guardianlore.g:oathwarden: It held the sky's oath. When the oath broke, it held on to the sky.
guardianlore.g:sand_matriarch: She buried the Lost City of the Desolated Plains once already.
guardianlore.g:ossuary_king: Crowned in the Burying Grounds of Mardoth, by the dead, for the dead.
guardianlore.g:bone_sovereign: Skorch's ash still clings to his bones.
guardianlore.g:cyclops_tyrant: Kin of Min Loduhr: what it cannot rule, it eats.
guardianlore.g:alpha_werewolf: The pack ran the Passage of Ash long before the settlers came.
guardianlore.g:ogre_warlord: Zul forged worlds. His blood only forges grudges.
guardianlore.g:hydra: The oldest hunger of the Kabarian Wetlands, and the most patient.
guardianlore.g:rock_titan: A cliff of Mardoth that learned to walk.
guardianlore.g:demon_warlord: Archeron's banner-bearer, come to collect what was sworn.
guardianlore.g:hellguard_captain: Sworn to Archeron. The oath held; the man did not.
guardianlore.g:vampire_lord: An echo of the Nightshade, wearing a nobleman's face.
guardianlore.g:ashen_wyrm: Elysia's brood still smoulders where the Ash Weaver fell.
guardianlore.g:elysia: Mother of the Ashen brood. Something warm still stirs beneath her.
guardianlore.g:jarl_hrafn: He swore his axe to the Oath, then sold it to the north wind.
guardianlore.g:hollow_knight: An oath-knight who kept his vow long after his heart gave out.
guardianlore.g:centaur_chieftain: He led the herds of Myrh when the Oath still held the meadows.
guardianlore.g:deep_warden: The dwarves sealed their dead below the halls and set a warden on the door. It still keeps it.
guardianlore.g:steel_guardian: The Tinkers wound it to guard their forges. No one came back to stop it.
guardianlore.g:antlered_hunger: It starved through the long winter under the old woods, and learned to call the roots to hold its meat still.
guardianlore.g:crystal_crasher: It broke out of the deep veins under Mardoth, and kept the crystals that grew on it.
guardianlore.g:anubis: He weighed every heart that entered the necropolis. He weighs yours.
