treeflavour.tf:starfall_n0: Look up. The sky remembers every spell you ever threw at it.
treeflavour.tf:souls_n0: Every bone that falls for you gives a little back.
treeflavour.tf:conduit_n0: Leave the door open while you work. Something will always come through.
treeflavour.tf:bow_n2: Draw slow. Loose once. Walk on.
treeflavour.tf:rain_n0: The Sylvan march never aimed. They simply made it rain.
treeflavour.tf:ki_n1: The mountain king left his hammer at the gate. He did not need it.
treeflavour.tf:mirrorblade_n0: Strike once. Let the shadow you left behind strike again.
treeflavour.tf:regrowth_n0: Cut the oak to the root and it still swears to the spring.
treeflavour.tf:artillery_n0: The dwarves of the deep hall wound their engines by song. Ours just swear faster.
treeflavour.tf:warpath_n0: Under the mountain they held one gate for three hundred years. You only need to hold this one.
treeflavour.tf:voidbound_n0: The void is never full. Neither, now, are you.
treeflavour.tf:manasteal_n0: The blade drinks. The arm that swings it never tires.
treeflavour.tf:twice_fallen_sky: What falls once was an accident. What falls twice was an oath.
treeflavour.tf:pyre_covenant: They swore to follow you into the fire. You held them to it.
treeflavour.tf:cascade_of_ruin: One falls, and the forest remembers.
treeflavour.tf:thousand_hands: Two blades, two fists, a thousand answers.
treeflavour.tf:one_breath: One breath in. One cut. The second breath is for the living.
treeflavour.tf:unbroken_wall: The gate of the deep hall never moved. Neither did the dwarves who held it.
treeflavour.tf:wake_of_spells: In the eye of the storm, every word you ever spoke comes back around.
treeflavour.tf:ancestral_host: The host remembers every oath. It does not need your hands to keep them.
treeflavour.tf:hollow_covenant: The hollow do not bleed. Somewhere under the mountain, the old dwarves knew it too.
treeflavour.tf:siege_pact: The engine-wrights paid for every bolt in blood. So will you.
treeflavour.tf:forked_sky: Every arrow is a question. Now each one asks it twice.
treeflavour.tf:tempest_vow: The two schools argued for a hundred years. Then the storm settled it.
treeflavour.tf:hammer_of_judgement: The anvil asks. The sky answers.
treeflavour.tf:dawnstorm_covenant: The tower and the temple shared one window. Through it, the dawn.
treeflavour.tf:choir_of_bones: They learned the old words. They sing them badly, and everything dies anyway.
treeflavour.tf:the_hunting_dead: The hounds were dead before the hunt began. It did not slow them.
treeflavour.tf:wind_and_steel_oath: The blade remembers the arrow. The arrow remembers the blade.
treeflavour.tf:earthbreaker_stride: Where the samurai stepped, the warrior's ground broke.
treeflavour.tf:aegis_rebuke: The shield was never a wall. It was a door, and the fire was behind it.
treeflavour.tf:comet_step: Fall like a star. Land like a sermon.
treeflavour.tf:holy_n0: The oath was never quiet. It only waited for a voice.
treeflavour.tf:malediction_n0: Speak the Woe slowly. Let every word take root.
treeflavour.tf:vowkeeper_n0: A Vow kept costs less with every dawn it survives.
treeflavour.tf:warcaller_n0: The old kings did not draw steel first. They drew breath.
treeflavour.tf:lingering_n0: A spell that ends is a spell that was rushed.
treeflavour.tf:malediction_n1: One sorrow is a burden. Two are a sentence.
treeflavour.tf:dawnsworn_n0: The vow is spoken with the edge, not the mouth.
treeflavour.tf:radiant_crusade: Every third blow is not yours. It is the morning's.
treeflavour.tf:blightword_n0: Sing it low. The rot hears everything.
treeflavour.tf:rotting_gospel: The dead were the first congregation. You preach to the living now.
treeflavour.tf:grave_sermon_n0: The dead keep perfect silence. Someone has to speak for them.
treeflavour.tf:longwinter_n0: Cast once. Let the winter do the rest.
treeflavour.tf:thunderhead_n0: One more spark than the sky can hold.
treeflavour.tf:ancvigil_n0: The ancestors do not tire. They only wait.
treeflavour.tf:stonecircle_n0: Another stone in the ring. Each one stands its ground.
treeflavour.tf:legion_n0: One kind. Twice as many. They do not share the grave.
treeflavour.tf:harmony_n0: The wall holds, the bows sing, the banner burns. Each needs the other.
treeflavour.tf:guardian_n0: It was a knight once. It kept the vow past the grave, and now the vow keeps it.
treeflavour.tf:guardian_n1: Two shields of light. The oath is heavier for it.

treeflavour.tf:eng_samurai_n0: Every kill a drumbeat. Stop, and the drum falls silent.

treeflavour.tf:r59_phys3_n1: The weapon is only as heavy as the hand that refuses to let go.
treeflavour.tf:r59_phys5_n1: One swing. The next. The next.
treeflavour.tf:r59_phys6_n1: Strike once. The air remembers, and strikes again.
treeflavour.tf:r59_sure_strike_k3: The mountain does not guess where it will fall.
treeflavour.tf:r59_mountain_n1: Some are born to carry the mountain.
treeflavour.tf:r59_mountain_k3: Every ounce of you is a weapon.
treeflavour.tf:r59_ignite_p_n1: What the light touches, it keeps burning.
treeflavour.tf:r59_shock_p_n1: Swear it loud enough and the sky answers.
treeflavour.tf:r59_shock_r_n1: Feathers cut from a storm crow.
treeflavour.tf:r59_freeze_r_n1: The arrow lands. The frost stays.
treeflavour.tf:r59_freeze_m_n1: Winter is patient. So are you.
treeflavour.tf:r59_poison_n_n1: It does not kill quickly. It does not need to.
treeflavour.tf:r59_hold_n1: The hunt does not end at the first quiet room.
treeflavour.tf:r59_hold_k3: The sentence is spoken. The hunt waits for it.
treeflavour.tf:r60_more_warrior_n1: Lift it once. Let it fall forever.
treeflavour.tf:r60_more_samurai_n1: One cut. Nothing left to fix.
treeflavour.tf:r60_more_paladin_n1: The arm is steel. The will is fire.
treeflavour.tf:r60_engine_warrior_n2: The war is not over. It is never over.
treeflavour.tf:r60_engine_samurai_n2: Every clean cut feeds the next.
treeflavour.tf:r60_engine_paladin_n2: Where it stands, the line holds.
treeflavour.tf:r60_cross60_n1: The dead keep the best notes.
treeflavour.tf:r60_cross0_n1: Dip it in the grave first.
treeflavour.tf:r60_cross0_n3: The wound is the second arrow.
treeflavour.tf:r60_cross300_n1: Far or near, the same calm.
treeflavour.tf:r60_cross300_n3: Know the wind. Cut through it.
treeflavour.tf:r60_cross240_n1: One teacher said strike hard. The other said strike true.
treeflavour.tf:r60_cross180_n3: Every blow a prayer. Every prayer a fire.
treeflavour.tf:r60_cross120_n1: Read the book. Then swing it.

treeflavour.tf:hallshaker_n0: The hall went quiet before the jarl spoke. It never stayed quiet after.
treeflavour.tf:stillwater_n0: The pond does not chase the moon. It waits, and the moon comes down to it.
treeflavour.tf:might_mage_dex: The fastest pen in the library also picked its locks.
treeflavour.tf:might_mage_str: Every tower was carried up one stone at a time.
treeflavour.tf:might_ranger_int: She read the sky before every long shot.
treeflavour.tf:might_ranger_str: A war bow is drawn with the back, not the arms.
treeflavour.tf:might_warrior_int: The old jarls knew a hundred battles by heart. They won the hundred and first.
treeflavour.tf:might_warrior_dex: Heavy steel, quick feet. The dead had it the other way round.
treeflavour.tf:might_necromancer_str: Somebody has to dig them up first.
treeflavour.tf:might_paladin_dex: A thousand miles of road teach the feet their own prayers.
treeflavour.tf:might_samurai_int: The same hand writes the poem and draws the sword.
treeflavour.tf:rimebound_n0: Cold is patient. It only has to be patient once.
treeflavour.tf:rimebound_n1: The frost on your coat is older than your oath.
treeflavour.tf:rimebound_n2: Spring was a promise. You did not make it.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_the_long_night: The night does not end. It is only waiting for you to stop.
treeflavour.tf:kindled_n0: A fire that is fed a little every hour never goes out.
treeflavour.tf:kindled_n1: Keep watch by the pyre. It keeps watch by you.
treeflavour.tf:kindled_n2: The second hour of a fire is worse than the first.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_the_pyre: Every vow is kindling. Yours burned the brightest.
treeflavour.tf:snarewright_n0: The best hunter is the one who was never there.
treeflavour.tf:snarewright_n1: Lie still long enough and the forest forgets you.
treeflavour.tf:snarewright_n2: A trap does not miss. It only waits for its moment.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_the_snare: You never fight. You only arrive after it is over.
treeflavour.tf:temper_warrior: Iron learns the forge. So does the hide that wears it.
treeflavour.tf:temper_paladin: The blow arrives as iron and leaves as embers.
treeflavour.tf:temper_ranger: Rain, frost and lightning taught the cloth what the arrow could not.
treeflavour.tf:temper_samurai: Breathe in the storm. Let the blade pass through it.
treeflavour.tf:temper_mage: The ward does not stop the hammer. It turns it into weather.
treeflavour.tf:temper_necromancer: Dead bone does not break. It goes cold.
treeflavour.tf:stormbound_n0: One bolt is weather. Two is a warning.
treeflavour.tf:stormbound_n1: The storm does not end with the man it struck.
treeflavour.tf:stormbound_n2: Hold the charge a heartbeat longer.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_the_living_storm: The sky remembers every oath sworn under it.
treeflavour.tf:wildfire_n0: Burn one tree and you have burned the forest.
treeflavour.tf:wildfire_n1: A second fire on the same coal burns hotter.
treeflavour.tf:wildfire_n2: The wind is the arsonist's best friend.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_many_fires: Many small fires. One great burning.
treeflavour.tf:shatterglass_n1: The cold does not hurt. It only takes.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_the_white_silence: Snow falls on the battlefield. Nothing else moves.
treeflavour.tf:bloodletter_n0: An axe does not need to kill. It only needs to open the door.
treeflavour.tf:bloodletter_n2: The wolves smell it before you do.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_the_red_harvest: The field is red. The harvest is in.
treeflavour.tf:crimson_edge_n0: The cut is so clean the enemy does not notice. Yet.
treeflavour.tf:crimson_edge_n1: It trails behind them like a banner.
treeflavour.tf:crimson_edge_n2: Small wounds. Many of them. Patience.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_a_thousand_cuts: The master does not strike hard. The master strikes often.
treeflavour.tf:slowruin_n0: What the hit begins, the hour completes.
treeflavour.tf:slowruin_n1: The wound is the doorway. The rot walks in.
treeflavour.tf:slowruin_n2: Nothing in the grave is ever in a hurry.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_slow_ruin: Everything ends. You only make sure of it.
treeflavour.tf:stormarrow_n0: Every arrow carries a little of the sky.
treeflavour.tf:stormarrow_n1: The bolt leaves the corpse looking for another.
treeflavour.tf:stormarrow_n2: Pull the string tighter. Let the storm wait.
treeflavour.tf:emberblade_n0: The blade passes. The grass behind it burns.
treeflavour.tf:emberblade_n1: A cut that keeps on cutting.
treeflavour.tf:emberblade_n2: Steel remembers the fire that made it.
treeflavour.tf:rimeward_n0: Even the faithful break when frozen.
treeflavour.tf:rimeward_n1: The vigil lasts until the thaw. There is no thaw.
treeflavour.tf:rimeward_n2: Cold enough to keep a saint.
treeflavour.tf:r70_duration_n0: The sky does not hurry. It only has to be there when you look up.
treeflavour.tf:r70_ignite_r_n0: Pitch on the shaft, a spark on the string. The rest is the wind's work.
treeflavour.tf:r74_galeeye_n0: Every spark I leave behind is still listening.
treeflavour.tf:r74_pitchbatt_n0: Light the rack, then step back.
treeflavour.tf:r74_hiddenedge_n0: The cut lands before the step does.
treeflavour.tf:r74_holyrite_n0: I speak the old words, and the ground remembers them.
treeflavour.tf:r79_intstack_n0: Some minds are too wide for one lifetime.
treeflavour.tf:r79_intstack_k0: Every thought you have is a spell waiting.
treeflavour.tf:oath_of_the_rolling_thunder: Every arrow is a cloud. Every volley, a storm.
treeflavour.tf:r87_cd_mage: The second word is always faster than the first.
treeflavour.tf:r87_cd_necromancer: They do not wait to be called twice.
treeflavour.tf:r87_cd_paladin: Faith does not rest between prayers.
treeflavour.tf:r87_cd_ranger: The next arrow is already on the string.
treeflavour.tf:r87_cd_samurai: Steel returns to the hand before the sheath is cold.
treeflavour.tf:r91_tankks_k0: Every blow they failed to land, I return.
